Bumps [gitpython](https://github.com/gitpython-developers/GitPython) from 3.1.59 to 3.2.1.
Release notes

Sourced from gitpython's releases.

3.2.1

What's Changed

  • prepare for next release, v3.2 by @​Byron in gitpython-developers/GitPython#2260
  • objects: decode a byte mode before reading its digits by @​SashaMIT in gitpython-developers/GitPython#2261
  • build(deps): bump https://github.com/astral-sh/ruff-pre-commit from v0.16.5 to 0.16.9 in the pre-commit group by @​dependabot[bot] in gitpython-developers/GitPython#2263
  • fix(submodule): validate destinations before mutation by @​Byron in gitpython-developers/GitPython#2264
  • fix(util): create lock files in one exclusive step by @​radhika1314 in gitpython-developers/GitPython#2267
  • fix(commit): accumulate gpgsig continuation lines in linear time by @​Keerthana-64 in gitpython-developers/GitPython#2268
  • fix(index): accept a single PathLike in checkout by @​kokotatan in gitpython-developers/GitPython#2269
  • fix(util): redact URL credentials without corrupting the host by @​yunaremaia in gitpython-developers/GitPython#2270
  • change line for changelogs by @​CrowZhen in gitpython-developers/GitPython#2272
  • fix(commit): reject identity fields that alter commit headers by @​Keerthana-64 in gitpython-developers/GitPython#2271
  • fix: stop stalled remote commands when their timeout expires by @​Byron in gitpython-developers/GitPython#2277
  • fix(util): reject symbolic links that alias .gitmodules by @​Keerthana-64 in gitpython-developers/GitPython#2278
  • fix: send one object name or path per git stdin record by @​Keerthana-64 in gitpython-developers/GitPython#2279
  • fix(stats): preserve whitespace in filenames by @​v1shay in gitpython-developers/GitPython#2280
  • fix(config): preserve exact large integer values by @​xiehuanyi in gitpython-developers/GitPython#2281
  • fix: resolve IterableList names independently of list attributes by @​FanWu-ai in gitpython-developers/GitPython#2283
  • fix relative blocking lock 20261011 by @​Byron in gitpython-developers/GitPython#2284

New Contributors

  • @​SashaMIT made their first contribution in gitpython-developers/GitPython#2261
  • @​kokotatan made their first contribution in gitpython-developers/GitPython#2269
  • @​yunaremaia made their first contribution in gitpython-developers/GitPython#2270
  • @​CrowZhen made their first contribution in gitpython-developers/GitPython#2272
  • @​v1shay made their first contribution in gitpython-developers/GitPython#2280
  • @​xiehuanyi made their first contribution in gitpython-developers/GitPython#2281
  • @​FanWu-ai made their first contribution in gitpython-developers/GitPython#2283

Full Changelog: https://github.com/gitpython-developers/GitPython/compare/3.2.0...3.2.1

3.2.0 - Security

What's Changed

  • test: cover subdirectory discovery and pathspec commands in bare-repository worktrees by @​christianvuerings in gitpython-developers/GitPython#2228
  • Read git's yes/no and on/off booleans in get_value by @​rawsun007 in gitpython-developers/GitPython#2229
  • Clarify detached HEAD access and isolate test branch state by @​Byron in gitpython-developers/GitPython#2231
  • Reject submodule move destinations through intermediate symlinks by @​Byron in gitpython-developers/GitPython#2232
  • fix: validate checkout positional reference options by @​Byron in gitpython-developers/GitPython#2233
  • Fix timeout child-process lookup on non-GNU systems by @​aprylewu in gitpython-developers/GitPython#2236
  • Preserve implicit boolean config keys by @​Byron in gitpython-developers/GitPython#2238
  • Reject comments after implicit boolean config keys by @​Byron in gitpython-developers/GitPython#2239
  • Fix case-insensitive Git config name matching by @​Byron in gitpython-developers/GitPython#2241
  • Move project metadata to pyproject.toml by @​mwtoews in gitpython-developers/GitPython#2242
  • Move [doc] extra to a PEP 735 dependency group; add uv-sync CI check by @​mwtoews in gitpython-developers/GitPython#2243
  • fix: strip inline config comments the way git does by @​rawsun007 in gitpython-developers/GitPython#2245
  • Drop Python 3.7 by @​mwtoews in gitpython-developers/GitPython#2246
  • fix: preserve positional operands in high-level Git commands by @​Byron in gitpython-developers/GitPython#2247
  • submodule: option to update without fetching by @​jeffro256 in gitpython-developers/GitPython#2244
  • bump minor version to indicate drop of python 3.7 support by @​Byron in gitpython-developers/GitPython#2248
  • fix: skip a UTF-8 BOM when reading config files by @​geek-alpha in gitpython-developers/GitPython#2249

... (truncated)

Changelog

Sourced from gitpython's changelog.

3.2.1

Security fixes for

  • https://github.com/gitpython-developers/GitPython/security/advisories/GHSA-83vg-56qc-22m7

If you can, also try and provide feedback on the upcoming v4 branch gitpython-developers/GitPython#2274 - patches welcome.

See the following for all changes. https://github.com/gitpython-developers/GitPython/releases/tag/3.2.1

3.2.0

Drops support for Python 3.7 (5 years after its EOL).

Security fixes for

  • Deprecate the pure-Python GitDB object database backend due to security and performance issues. Selecting it or a subclass through odbt now emits a DeprecationWarning. Remove odbt=GitDB to use GitCmdObjectDB, the existing default, or select odbt=GitCmdObjectDB explicitly. The gitdb package remains a dependency for shared types and utilities.
  • https://github.com/gitpython-developers/GitPython/security/advisories/GHSA-gq48-pqfc-9p58
  • https://github.com/gitpython-developers/GitPython/security/advisories/GHSA-23mf-xhv8-69c2
  • https://github.com/gitpython-developers/GitPython/security/advisories/GHSA-f9j4-qggq-h239
  • https://github.com/gitpython-developers/GitPython/security/advisories/GHSA-w8jc-g24h-crhw
  • https://github.com/gitpython-developers/GitPython/security/advisories/GHSA-m64x-33q8-m5h7
  • https://github.com/gitpython-developers/GitPython/security/advisories/GHSA-fx3j-rwgx-fr94

If you can, also try and provide feedback on the upcoming v4 branch gitpython-developers/GitPython#2274 - patches welcome.

See the following for all changes. https://github.com/gitpython-developers/GitPython/releases/tag/3.2.0

3.1.62

Security fixes for

  • https://github.com/gitpython-developers/GitPython/security/advisories/GHSA-59cr-6r3x-644w

If you can, also try and provide feedback on the upcoming v4 branch gitpython-developers/GitPython#2274 - patches welcome.

See the following for all changes. https://github.com/gitpython-developers/GitPython/releases/tag/3.1.62

... (truncated)

  • 97eadb8 fix(submodule): validate destinations before mutation
  • 6a7180a prepare for next release, v3.2
  • 0b64501 refactor(db): deprecate the pure-Python GitDB backend
  • 9349ff5 fix(repo): preserve literal separate Git directory paths
  • 8290c98 fix: bound actor and date parsing
  • 9ad28cc fix: complete safety checks in Git command wrappers
  • ce2093b bump minor version to indicate drop of python 3.7 support
  • dafafff Merge pull request #2247 from gitpython-developers/pos-arg-sanitization
